decisions.reason: By 2022 the market signal from this 2018 CD should be largely known, and as a relatively weak strategic fit with the firm's specialist long-tail identity it is more likely to be discontinued than kept.
This series appears differentiated and close to the firm's curation-led model, so with low online listing costs and some continuing option value it is worth keeping for now.
A jazz vinyl reissue fits the firm's collector-oriented niche and physical-media strengths, making continued availability more attractive than early withdrawal.

A multi-disc box set ties up more capital and storage space, and after several years the uncertainty should be mostly resolved, so a specialist retailer would likely prune it if it has not clearly proven itself.

Because this compilation CD appears to have received the lightest market commitment from the start, management would likely reallocate attention and stock space away from it once its limited upside became apparent.
